verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly state you can add a custom domain, manage DNS records, and get SSL certificates automatically. The CLI docs corroborate DNS and certificate management, and the MCP tools add domain availability and purchase. The core of the story is clearly delivered, but the evidence is short first-party claims only. Missing for 10: in-depth domain-attachment docs (verification steps, apex vs subdomain configuration, per-deployment/environment domain assignment) and independent or hands-on corroboration.
